description: Execute a trade the agent authorized by signature. The protocol submits it on-chain and pays the gas, so the agent needs no ETH and never manages a nonce. Sign the `signPayload` from problee_prepare_trade, then call this. Re-posting the same signed intent is safe — the digest can only execute once.

EvmAddress.description: Checksummed or lowercase 20-byte EVM address (0x + 40 hex).

WeiString.description: Non-negative integer amount in the token's smallest unit (wei for ETH-family tokens; the play-money token PM uses 6). Always read the decimals from the token or market metadata rather than assuming them. Serialized as a base-10 string to avoid JS number precision loss.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

name: problee_execute_trade_intent
title: Execute a signed trade intent (protocol submits and pays gas)
